name: Claim
description: A factual proposition with explicit evidence and verification state.

key.description: Stable key used to group equivalent or conflicting claims.

subject.description: Entity or other host reference that the claim describes.

evidence.description: Block or source ids that support or dispute the proposition.

validation: key should be stable across equivalent or conflicting claims
evidence refs should resolve to known blocks or source manifest entries
confidence should be between 0.0 and 1.0 when present
resolved claims should preserve the evidence used for resolution
